title: Kitchen Table: ad-free, account-free classic family board games across phones in the same room or async
user: Couples and parents who want simple games with a partner or kids on separate phones without ads, IAP, accounts, or tracking.
smallest_useful_product: A room-code lobby with three public-domain games: a Parcheesi/Ludo-style race, dots-and-boxes, and a simple dice-score game. Realtime in the room and resumable asynchronously by link.
constraints: Public-domain rules and original presentation only; authoritative server; nicknames only; no matchmaking, chat, ranking, ads, tracking, or payment.
success_measure: At least half of created rooms complete a game, at least 30% return within seven days, and zero ad impressions by design.
